homograph.note: The exam sense (a faulty product, especially a car) is informal American slang and gives a reader no way to reach it from the fruit; a card that shows only the fruit teaches the wrong thing.

senses.definition: something, especially a car, that turns out to be badly made or faulty after you have bought it

examples.en: The laptop he ordered online turned out to be a complete lemon.
examples.fa: لپ‌تاپی که آنلاین سفارش داد کاملاً معیوب از آب درآمد.

senses.definition: a yellow citrus fruit with sour juice, used in cooking and drinks

examples.en: She squeezed half a lemon over the grilled fish.
examples.fa: نصف یک لیمو را روی ماهی کبابی چلاند.
